sealed_record.thesis: The market is pricing PONS as a peer of the LONG-platform tokens when the fee plumbing is structurally opposite: on LONG, $1 of trading fee recycles into the RWA vault, pool depth and supply burn, while on PONS the bonding-curve/fixed-supply design lets the same $1 exit and never return, and the RWA pairing is cosmetic rather than a claim. That means PONS has no reflexive bid underneath it once volume decays, while its LONG-side competitors do. Dune top-500 holder cohorts as of Sep 2 show PONS at 50.0% fresh money (wallets accumulating <14 days), the weakest holder base of the three tokens measured versus CASHCAT at 21.6% fresh - a float dominated by recent buyers with no fee-driven reason to stay. A respected short-side operator flagged PONS as a 'generational short again' on Sep 6 and only cut the position on Sep 15 for risk reasons, not thesis reasons, which is exactly the setup where the crowded side has already been flushed.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP +80.1%. Short ditutup untuk mengunci hasil saat seluruh buku call di-unwind.
